map.title: Map Instructions
map.one: Left Click on two (or more) points to draw a line showing the distance between them.
map.two: Press <key>Enter</key> to finish drawing one shape and start another.
map.three: Press <undo>Ctrl + Z</undo> to undo and <redo>Ctrl + Y</redo> to redo.
map.four: Right Click to add a destination point.
map.five: Use the mouse wheel or zoom buttons to zoom in or out.

forms.title: Formation Instructions
forms.one: Use the formation buttons in the center of the navigation bar <icons></icons> to configure drone formations around a selected location.
forms.two: After selecting a point on the map, choose the number of drones (from 1 to 12) and specify a radius.
forms.three: The drones will then automatically fly to the selected location and position themselves evenly spaced around the target point at the specified radius.

control.title: Control Instructions
control.one: All connected drones' telemetry data can be viewed in the data table located below the map.
control.two: The panel contains two tabs: the <drones>Drones</drones> tab and the <destinations>Destinations</destinations> tab.
control.three: The Drones tab displays real-time telemetry information for all registered drones, such as relative altitude, battery level, latitude, longitude, and other status data.
control.four: The Destinations tab shows all destination points that have been selected or placed on the map.
control.five: Within the Drones tab, you can use the <settings>Settings</settings> button to send custom commands to individual drones.
control.six: For example, selecting <camera>Open Camera</camera> will open a panel displaying the live video stream from the camera mounted on the selected drone.

radius.title: Radius (m)
radius.description: Drones will be positioned evenly spaced around the target point at this radius (in meters).
